platform: RTRFM 92.1 Perth Worldwide Digital Form and Optional Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: RTRFM uses a JavaScript submission form that requests contact details, location, artist biography, social links, upcoming gigs, a streaming link and a freely downloadable audio link; it also contains a hidden validation/honeypot field. Biography upload, link permissions, release timing and any optional physical delivery must be checked and completed by a human.

platform: CFRU 93.3 Guelph Digital EP and Album Download-Link Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CFRU accepts only EPs or albums containing at least three different tracks and requires artist/album information, a track list, contact information and a downloadable high-quality MP3 package. A human must confirm release eligibility, prepare the metadata and verify that the download link is accessible before using the official music mailbox.

platform: CJAM 99.1 Windsor Digital Four-Track-Plus Album Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CJAM requires a downloadable Dropbox, WeTransfer or Google Drive album link with at least four original tracks, properly named and tagged files, artist/release information and an EPK or equivalent email copy. Spotify links and direct MP3 attachments are explicitly rejected, so package preparation and delivery require human review.

platform: CFCR 90.5 Saskatoon Digital Album and EP File-Sharing Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CFCR requests properly labelled Album/EP MP3s, preferably 192 kbps, delivered through a file-sharing service rather than email attachments, with offensive-language disclosure. A human must prepare the album folder, metadata and accessible link and understand that the station responds only when a release is added.

platform: CFRO 100.5 Vancouver Co-operative Radio Music Library ZIP Upload Form Route
manual_review_reason: CFRO accepts local and non-local artists through a JavaScript upload form requiring a ZIP file up to 250 MB containing correctly named and tagged 320 kbps MP3s, plus release metadata, track list, CanCon status, CRTC category, genre and suggested shows. File preparation, rights checks, CanCon/category selection and the upload must be completed manually.
